name: Security Analysis
description:
Security Analysis folder consists of activities related to Threat, attack categories, Blocked and allowed contents, Clients IPs location, Malicious IPs, all Web firewall related logs, attack severity, attacks by services etc.

Folder contains an overview dashboard to get a look at various activities happening within the system at high level like attack severity, top attackers, top attacked domains, top attacked services and Threat Intelligence dashboard to have a more granular view of the attacks performed on you system.

children.name: Barracuda WAF - Security Overview
children.description: The Barracuda WAF - Security Overview Dashboard provides an at-a-glance view of alerts, WAF rules triggered and attacks detected by both Sumo Logic Threat Intel and Barracuda WAF.

panels.name: Alerts Severity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/barracuda/waf " WF "
| parse regex "(?<Unit_Name>[^ ]+) WF(?<Log>.*)"
| parse field=Log " * * * * * * * * * * [*] * * * * \"*\" * * * * *" as Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Client_Port, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Action, Follow_Up_Action, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer, UID
| if(Severity matches "ALE*", "ALERT", if(Severity matches "EME*", "EMERGENCY", if(Severity matches "CRI*", "CRITICAL", if(Severity matches "ERR*", "ERROR", if(Severity matches "WAR*", "WARNING", if(Severity matches "NOT*", "NOTICE", if(Severity matches "INF*", "INFORMATION", if(Severity matches "DEB*", "DEBUG", "")))))))) as Severity_Level
| topk(1, Severity_Level) by UID, Unit_Name, Attack_Type
| timeslice 1h
| count as Count by _timeSlice, Severity_Level
| fillmissing timeslice(1h), values("ALERT", "EMERGENCY", "CRITICAL", "ERROR", "WARNING", "NOTICE", "INFORMATION", "DEBUG") in Severity_Level
| transpose row _timeslice column Severity_Level
| sort by _timeslice

panels.name: Attacks by Service IP
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/barracuda/waf " WF "
| parse regex "(?<Unit_Name>[^ ]+) WF(?<Log>.*)"
| parse field=Log " * * * * * * * * * * [*] * * * * \"*\" * * * * *" as Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Client_Port, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Action, Follow_Up_Action, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer, UID
| concat(Service_Ip,":",Service_Port) as Service
| topk(1, Service) by UID, Unit_Name, Attack_Type
| timeslice 15m
| count as Count by _timeslice, Service
| filter Service in (sum(Count) by Service | top 5 Service by _sum )
| transpose row _timeslice column Service
| fillmissing timeslice(15m)

panels.name: Allowed Traffic - Threat Intel - Confidence
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/barracuda/waf " WF " ("LOG" OR "WARN" OR "CLOAK")
| parse regex "(?<Unit_Name>[^ ]+) WF(?<Log>.*)"
| parse field=Log " * * * * * * * * * * [*] * * * * \"*\" * * * * *" as Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Client_Port, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Action, Follow_Up_Action, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer, UID
| where Action in ("LOG", "WARN", "CLOAK")
| count as allowed_ips by Client_Ip
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=Client_Ip 
| where  type="ip_address" and !isNull(malicious_confidence)
| if (isEmpty(actor), "Unassigned", actor) as Actor
| sum (allowed_ips) as threat_count by malicious_confidence
| sort by threat_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/barracuda/waf " WF " ("LOG" OR "WARN" OR "CLOAK")
| parse regex "(?<Unit_Name>[^ ]+) WF(?<Log>.*)"
| parse field=Log " * * * * * * * * * * [*] * * * * \"*\" * * * * *" as Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Client_Port, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Action, Follow_Up_Action, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer, UID
| where Action in ("LOG", "WARN", "CLOAK")
| topk(1, Client_Ip) by UID, Unit_Name, Attack_Type
| concat(Service_Ip, ":",Service_Port) as Service
| lookup Severity as Attack_Severity, Attack_Category as Attack_Category from https://s3.amazonaws.com/sumologic-app-data/Barracuda_Attack_Description_and_Category.csv on Attack_Name=Attack_Type
| tourl("https://campus.barracuda.com/product/webapplicationfirewall/doc/29819001/attacks-description-action-policy", Attack_Type) as Attack_Type
| count as Count by Client_Ip, Attack_Type, Attack_Details, Attack_Category, Attack_Severity
| sort by Count
| limit 10

panels.name: Blocked Traffic - Details
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/barracuda/waf " WF " "DENY"
| parse regex "(?<Unit_Name>[^ ]+) WF(?<Log>.*)"
| parse field=Log " * * * * * * * * * * [*] * * * * \"*\" * * * * *" as Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Client_Port, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Action, Follow_Up_Action, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer, UID
| where Action matches "DENY"
|topk(1, Client_Ip) by UID, Unit_Name, Attack_Type
| concat(Service_Ip, ":",Service_Port) as Service
| lookup Severity, Attack_Category from https://s3.amazonaws.com/sumologic-app-data/Barracuda_Attack_Description_and_Category.csv on Attack_Name=Attack_Type
| tourl("https://campus.barracuda.com/product/webapplicationfirewall/doc/29819001/attacks-description-action-policy", Attack_Type) as Attack_Type
| count as Count by Client_Ip, Attack_Type, Attack_Details, Attack_Category, Severity
| sort by Count
| limit 10

panels.name: Recent - Attacks
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/barracuda/waf " WF "
| parse regex "(?<Unit_Name>[^ ]+) WF(?<Log>.*)"
| parse field=Log " * * * * * * * * * * [*] * * * * \"*\" * * * * *" as Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Client_Port, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Action, Follow_Up_Action, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer, UID
| formatDate(_messageTime, "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss") as messageDate
| where Unit_Name matches {{Unit_Name}} AND UID matches {{UID}} AND Action matches {{Action}} AND Severity matches {{Severity}} AND Attack_Type matches {{Attack_Type}} AND Client_Ip matches {{Client_Ip}} AND Service_Ip matches {{Service_Ip}} AND Service_Port matches {{Service_Port}} AND Rule matches {{Rule}}
| count by messageDate, Unit_Name, UID, Action, Severity, Attack_Type, Client_Ip, Service_Ip, Service_Port, Rule, Rule_Type, Attack_Details, Method, URL, Protocol, Session_Id, User_Agent, Proxy_Ip, Proxy_Port, User, Referrer
| sort by messageDate
| fields - _count
| limit 50
